_doc: Skill gates and skill providers for verify.py (module 'gates'). Seeded 28 Oct 2026 from every recipe, trainer and
'Fish to N' / cook-to-N string in the guide at TOC 2026.10.27. Matching is a literal substring on the step line.
providers: 'learn' = the profession is learned here (skill 1, cap 75); 'target' = the route expects the skill to be
at least N after this step; 'rank' = the cap after this trainer/book (Journeyman 150, Expert 225).
gates: 'min' = skill needed; 'mode' = what the check demands at that point of the route:
learned = profession known (buy-now items the guide says to learn later), rank = known and cap >= min,
target = known, cap >= min and the last stated target >= min (learn-it-now recipes, trainer ranks).
'level' = character level needed, checked against the chapter's [N min-max] lower bound.
source: 'Forever tooltip item N (28 Oct 2026)' = nether.wowhead.com/forever/tooltip/item/N; 'Classic' = unverified on Forever.
